support_policy.current_boundary: The exact Rust 1.97.1 toolchain is the only supported compiler boundary until a separate packet proves a lower MSRV on the complete locked workspace.
support_policy.lower_toolchains: Edition availability alone is not MSRV evidence. A lower rust-version requires locked dependency resolution, complete compilation and applicable tests on that exact compiler.
support_policy.upgrade_rule: A toolchain change must remain isolated from dependency upgrades and product behavior, regenerate measurement artifacts and pass unchanged exact-head acceptance.

adoption_policy.legacy_cohort: The 113 packages accepted before this policy are a measured migration cohort. Missing inheritance and the three exact direct-lint exceptions may only decrease in homogeneous behavior-neutral packets.
adoption_policy.new_workspace_members: Every new workspace package must set rust-version.workspace = true and [lints] workspace = true before acceptance.
adoption_policy.direct_overrides: Direct package rust-version declarations are forbidden. The three measured direct lint tables require exact active architecture-governance exceptions and are frozen by permanent tests; no additional direct lint table is permitted.
adoption_policy.target: All workspace packages inherit the workspace rust-version and lint policy.

resolver_policy.reason: Repository step 1 must not change dependency resolution or Cargo.lock. Resolver 3 adoption requires a separate measured dependency-resolution packet with exact lockfile evidence.
resolver_policy.removal_condition: Move to resolver 3 only after an isolated packet proves no unintended dependency, MSRV, feature or lockfile drift under the accepted toolchain.
